ssh_public_key.ui:title: SSH Public Key
ssh_public_key.ui:description: SSH public key for the admin user. Password login is disabled and no SSH port is open.

vm_size.ui:title: VM Size
vm_size.ui:description: VM size of the scale set instances. Must support Trusted Launch (Gen2).

encryption_at_host_enabled.ui:title: Encryption at host enabled
encryption_at_host_enabled.ui:description: Encrypt temp disk and caches on the host. Needs the EncryptionAtHost feature registered in the subscription.

allowed_http_cidrs.ui:title: Allowed CIDR
allowed_http_cidrs.ui:description: IPv4 CIDRs allowed to reach the Application Gateway. The web app is public by default.

log_retention_days.ui:title: Log Retention Days
log_retention_days.ui:description: Retention of the logs in Log Analytics

advanced_settings.ui:title: Advanced Settings
advanced_settings.ui:description: Optional settings, most deployments keep the defaults
